description_en: Call ListContactFlows to retrieve the IVR contact flows for a specified instance
description_zh: 调用ListContactFlows获取指定实例下的IVR联系流列表
kebab_example: aliyun ccc list-contact-flows --instance-id ccc-test --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --type MAIN_FLOW --sort-order DESC --order-by-field updatedTime --search-pattern example-string --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListContactFlows

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: Specifies the type of IVR flow to list. If you omit this parameter, IVR flows of all types are listed
parameters.help_zh: 按IVR流程类型过滤，非必填，默认为空，为空表示不过滤
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:

- `ASC`: The results are sorted in ascending order.

- `DESC`: The results are sorted in descending order. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
排序方向。取值范围：
- **ASC**：升序
- **DESC**（默认值）：降序
parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.help_en: The field by which to sort the results. Default value: updatedTime
parameters.name: order_by_field

parameters.help_en: A keyword to search for in the names or descriptions of IVR flows
parameters.name: search_pattern
